description: A battered oval of felt gone bald in patches, ringed by four mismatched chairs under a tin lamp. The deck's hand-shuffled and squared at the dealer's end; the chips are old casino clay nobody asks the provenance of. Cards are dealt by hand and called aloud here — the Reach plays close, and cheating gets you planted out in the scrub. A board scratched into the rail reads: 10/20 · $200 TO SIT · NO MARKERS.
name: the poker table
